story: Sonja was fresh out of high school, ready to make a name for herself. With determined steps she walked to the nearest Hollywood director.
Being young and pretty, Sonja quickly got a role in a movie. She was to be a florist, selling roses to the movie lead.
image: Sonja in a flower shop, with beautiful flowers on display. She is seen selling roses to a handsome man.

story: As the movie progressed, Sonja realised she was enjoying the job as a fake florist a lot more than the acting job itself.
image: Sonja dressed as a florist, in deep contemplation, while the rest of the cast are shooting a new scene.

story: She realised she did not want to be an actress. She wanted to make the world beautiful with flowers and gardening!
She had finally found peace, making gardens and helping people crearte beautiful flower displays.
image: Sonja working in a garden with a happy woman looking at the beautiful plants and flowers Sonja planted.
